notes: Summary: National critical-ops provider operating regional control centers for utilities and transport. Heavy constraints on external connectivity; primary ask = fully air-gapped Private deployment with optional shuttle for controlled model updates.
Contact: Dir. of Digital Operations = Mark Hollis (primary technical sponsor); CISO = Dr. Priya Raman (security reviewer).

Early asks: must run vetted open models on-prem, support quantized weights, no egress telemetry, optional offline model update mechanism (sneakernet or signed image), FIPS-ready crypto and HSM-backed key storage.
Security: 'We cannot allow any outbound tokenization or telemetry without an approved channel' — CISO quote on 2026-02-22 call.

POC scope proposed: 6-week on-prem PoC in one control center (air-gapped rack), demo operator chat for incident triage, embeddings index for SOPs and maintenance logs, reranking pipeline for alarm triage.

Latency/throughput: median response < 350ms for short operator prompts (≤256 tokens) under single-concurrent-assistant workload; burst to 20 req/s for shift-handover summaries acceptable with dedicated GPU pool.
Cost sensitivity: medium — capital-heavy procurement preferred; prefer firm fixed pricing for Dedicated/Private support and on-prem licensing rather than usage-only for air-gapped deployments.
Integration notes: must integrate with on-prem SSO (SAML 2.0) and existing SIEM via secure pull only; audit logs retained 7 years as per regulatory requirement.

Regulatory: must produce artifact for internal Risk Board: architecture diagram, data flow, POA&M, signed crypto compliance (FIPS), and vendor security questionnaire (v2 completed, awaiting evidence for HSM configuration).
Procurement cadence: engaged with procurement and legal — expectation: review in May, decision by end of June if PoC acceptable. Preferred contract term: 3 years with renewal option.
Stated blockers: on-site network isolation design (network team), procurement sign-off for HSM, POC rack availability.
Quotes from operators: 'If this can cut manual triage time by 40% we can justify capital spend' — Operations lead, 2026-01-18.
Next technical step: run closed test of model image signing flow and signed-image boot on isolated rack; coordinate with infra for air-gap handoff process (sneakernet cadence).
Drive artifacts: security questionnaire v2 uploaded; preliminary SOW (draft) uploaded.
